description: Open the TranscriptLab launcher view, where the user can work with transcripts visually and send one into the chat with "Discuss in chat". Use tab "upload" when a file needs the uploader: the user wants to pick a local audio or video file, the attached file is too large or could not be read by transcriptlab_transcribe_file, or that upload failed. Use "library" to reopen earlier transcripts, and "link" (the default) to paste a YouTube link. Also offer it when the user wants a transcript but has given no link or file.

tab.description: Which launcher tab to show first; defaults to link.

name: transcriptlab_open
title: Open TranscriptLab
